metadata.description: Condense vulnerability writeups into minimal reports

plugins.name: minimize-vuln-report
plugins.description: Condense any vulnerability writeup (advisories, bounty and pentest reports, SAST/SARIF, fuzzer crashes, AI-generated findings, Scrutineer bundles, pasted text) into a minimal report: a short issue description, a minimal proof of concept, and a minimal patch, tested in a Docker container when one is available.
